evidence.summary: Canonical SMS path has kill switch, opt-out fail-closed suppression, tenant compliance gate, shared-campaign purpose guard, rate limiting, provider orchestration, and ambiguity/manual-resolution handling. No explicit GrowthOS reactivation purpose exists.

Tenant SMS program and linked-number authority exist, but current data does not by itself prove the registered campaign/use case, sample messages, and opt-in evidence cover dormant-lead marketing reactivation.
Wiserr doctrine requires new product SMS purposes to receive compliance review and shared-campaign allowlist review before use.

GrowthOS now requires a certified canonical submission-result classification/evidence/reconciliation contract. That return-path contract has not yet been proven in Wiserr and therefore cannot support execution certification.

notes: Observed only. SMS transport availability, an active LOW_VOLUME_MIXED campaign, or the existing follow_up/luna_sms purposes must not be treated as GrowthOS marketing authority. Certification requires an explicit growth_reactivation purpose, approved compliance review, shared-campaign allowlist approval, verified carrier/use-case/sample/opt-in coverage, retained canonical send safeguards, canonical submission-result classification with durable evidence references, suppression classification preservation, and an ambiguity lookup/reconciliation contract.
